description: Source code for managing and iterating over reftable data structures, including parsing footer, initializing and navigating table blocks, and handling references and iterators.

classes.name: struct table_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing table blocks and records.

methods.name: table_offsets_for
methods.description: Returns the offsets structure for a given block type within a reftable.

methods.name: parse_footer
methods.description: Parses the footer of a reftable to initialize table metadata.

methods.name: table_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes a table iterator for traversing table blocks.

methods.name: table_iter_next_in_block
methods.description: Retrieves the next record within the current block.

methods.name: table_iter_block_done
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the current block in iteration.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a block within the table for reading.

methods.name: table_iter_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a table iterator.

methods.name: table_iter_next_block
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next block.

methods.name: table_iter_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next record from the table.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_to
methods.description: Seeks the iterator to a specific offset and type.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_start
methods.description: Seeks to the start position for a given block type.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_linear
methods.description: Performs a linear seek within the table to find a specific record.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_indexed
methods.description: Performs a seek using the index structure to locate a record.

methods.name: table_iter_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a record within the table, using index if available.

methods.name: table_iter_seek_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of seek function.

methods.name: table_iter_next_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of next function.

methods.name: table_iter_close_void
methods.description: Void pointer version of close function.

methods.name: iterator_from_table_iter
methods.description: Creates a generic iterator from a table iterator.

methods.name: reftable_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new reftable and reads its footer.

methods.name: reftable_table_incref
methods.description: Increments reference count for a reftable.

methods.name: reftable_table_decref
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases reftable if zero.

methods.name: reftable_table_refs_for
methods.description: Retrieves references for a given object ID.

methods.name: reftable_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index.

methods.name: reftable_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over the table.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a table iterator.

methods.name: reftable_table_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the table iterator to the next block.
